# nexus nexusd update

Update nexusd from a signed release

Installs the release tarball staged as uploadId. Before any operation exists it is refused with update-not-configured (no trusted key), upload-not-found, update-signature-invalid, update-package-invalid, or 409 version-downgrade (an older version without allowDowngrade); the same version succeeds with changed false. Side effects: the current binary and unit file are saved as the rollback copy, the package's install.sh runs as root, and nexusd restarts once onto the new version. If install, restart or the health check fails, the previous binary is restored and the operation fails with update-failed and rolledBack true, or update-rollback-failed if the restore also fails. Long-running: answers 202 with an operation. It runs in a systemd unit (systemd hosts only, not OpenRC) outside the sandbox, and the daemon that is running when the unit ends records the outcome. The CLI keeps reconnecting for up to 60 seconds while nexusd restarts. Restarting nexusd neither waits for nor cancels other operations: in-process operations of other providers end outcome-unknown, and detached operations survive. Reload, restart, update and rollback share one lane: a second request while one is queued or running answers 409 naming the blocking operation. It can be canceled only while queued. Requires nexusd:admin, which is root-equivalent.

## Usage

```
nexus nexusd update [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Update nexusd from a signed release
  nexus nexusd update --file <path>
  # The same, safe to retry
  nexus nexusd update --file <path> --idempotency-key <key>
```

## Flags

```
      --allow-downgrade          Install a package older than the running version. Default false.
      --file string              Release tarball to install, nexusd-<version>-linux-amd64.tar.gz. Required.
      --filter stringArray       key=value, repeatable: print only objects whose dot path has this value; a repeated key matches any of its values
      --follow                   stream the operation's output to stderr while waiting
  -h, --help                     help for update
      --idempotency-key string   Idempotency-Key header: a retry with the same key and input returns the original operation (at most 255 visible ASCII characters)
      --no-wait                  print the operation as accepted and exit, without waiting for it to end
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json, jsonl, yaml (default table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise)
      --select strings           print only these dot paths of each object, comma-separated, such as name,properties.state; host and id are always kept
      --signature string         Signature file of the tarball. Default <file>.sig.
      --tag strings              target every configured host with this tag; comma-separated or repeated for any of several
      --timeout duration         stop waiting after this long, such as 90s or 5m, and exit 7; the operation is not canceled
      --yes                      do not ask for confirmation; required to mutate without a terminal
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
